detail.title: Review of Autocatalytic Memory Believability and Submatrix Conditions
detail.summary: Reviewed belief-autocatalytic-memory-1 using newly linked evidence peer-4a54106b1f205db0b51b8514, confirming that while dynamical systems selected for persistence retain historical state features, open questions remain regarding whether macroscopic memory persists independently of underlying microstate dynamics.
